tickets.subject: Seat role reset to default again
tickets.body: My seat role got reset to viewer overnight for the second time this quarter. Had to ask a colleague to bump me back up just to keep working.

tickets.subject: Alert thresholds not saving
tickets.body: Set alert thresholds three times this week and they keep reverting to default overnight. Not sure what's holding onto the old config.

tickets.subject: Connector sync gaps, missing a full day
tickets.body: Noticed a full day of data missing from our warehouse connector - sync log shows it ran, but the numbers don't match. Second connector oddity this month.

tickets.subject: Export cutting off partway through
tickets.body: Large export is cutting off at exactly 10,000 rows with no warning, even though the report has more. Happening consistently now, not a one-off.

tickets.subject: Export issue still not actually fixed
tickets.body: This is the same row-cutoff problem from last week, not a new one - whatever was 'fixed' clearly wasn't. Thirteen days feels long for something this specific.

tickets.subject: Exports broken again, different report this time
tickets.body: Different report, same symptom - cuts off partway with no error. Starting to think this is systemic rather than report-specific.

tickets.subject: API returning truncated data too
tickets.body: Now the API is returning truncated result sets, same shape of bug as the export cutoffs. Would like confirmation these are actually the same root cause before I keep chasing separate tickets for what's one issue.

tickets.subject: Re: truncation bug - still happening a week later
tickets.body: Week later and still seeing truncated API responses intermittently. This has now touched exports, the API, and cost us real analyst time re-running things.

tickets.subject: Escalating - pattern of data truncation across modules
tickets.body: I want to escalate formally. Since the winter we've had recurring truncation issues across exports and API, seat resets, and alert config not saving. Individually resolved, but I need someone to look at whether there's a shared cause before it happens again.

tickets.subject: Re: escalation - API truncating again while we wait
tickets.body: Still waiting on a substantive response to the escalation, and the API truncation is back in the meantime. This is exactly the pattern I flagged in June.

tickets.subject: Re: escalation - alert config reverting, same as December
tickets.body: Alert thresholds reverted again, same issue as back in December when this all started. I'd like this treated as one investigation, not another one-off ticket.

tickets.subject: Re: escalation - seat role reset once more
tickets.body: My seat role reset to viewer again, exactly like the very first ticket in this whole saga. Eight months of the same handful of issues cycling through.

tickets.subject: Update since the escalation review
tickets.body: Wanted to note the connector sync gap that came up this week actually got a real explanation for once, not just a reset. Feels like the escalation is finally landing somewhere.

tickets.subject: Seat roles holding steady since the fix
tickets.body: Roles have held since whatever changed this week - no resets for the first time in months. Following up on a smaller seat question while things are stable: can we get a report of role changes going forward?

tickets.subject: API stable, one remaining question
tickets.body: No truncation issues since the changes went in. One remaining question - is there a way to get notified if truncation ever happens again, rather than us catching it manually?

tickets.subject: Alert config holding too
tickets.body: Same day update - alert thresholds have held for the first stretch in a long time. Good timing given the question I just sent about failure notifications.

tickets.subject: Connector running smoothly, small tweak request
tickets.body: Everything's been steady for a few weeks now. Small ask - could the sync log include a timestamp per table rather than just per run?

tickets.subject: Report builder feature question
tickets.body: Things have been calm enough that I've had time to actually explore Report Builder properly. Is there a way to save a formula as a reusable snippet across reports?

tickets.subject: Adding a second connector, first time in a while
tickets.body: Looking to add a connector for a new data source, first new setup we've done in a while rather than fixing something old. Can you send over the requirements?

tickets.subject: Re: new connector - mapping question
tickets.body: Quick follow-up on the new connector setup - how do we map two fields with the same name from different source tables?

tickets.subject: API question for the new connector's data
tickets.body: Now that the second connector is in, is there a single API endpoint that returns combined data from both, or do we need to call each separately?

tickets.subject: Bulk role update for reorganised team
tickets.body: We've reorganised our reporting team and need about fifteen users moved to a different role at once. Is there a faster way than doing it one by one through the admin console?

tickets.subject: Export template broke after the reorg
tickets.body: Since moving the team around, one of our shared export templates is pulling from the wrong department filter. Might be linked to the role changes from last week.

tickets.subject: Connector permissions after the reorg
tickets.body: Similar to the export template issue - a couple of connectors seem to have lost their permission mapping since the team reorg. Can you check if role changes affect connector access?

tickets.subject: Seat count review ahead of renewal
tickets.body: Ahead of our renewal conversation, could you send a current breakdown of active seats versus what we're licensed for? Want to make sure we're not over- or under-provisioned.

tickets.subject: Report builder - shared template versioning
tickets.body: When two people edit the same shared report template, is there any version history, or does the latest save just overwrite silently? Had a near-miss where someone's changes were lost.

tickets.subject: Connector question - multiple environments
tickets.body: We're setting up a staging environment alongside production - can one connector feed both, or do we need a second connector licence for staging?

tickets.subject: Export destination - adding a second recipient list
tickets.body: Straightforward one - can a scheduled export go to two separate distribution lists instead of just one?

tickets.subject: Export formatting - decimal places inconsistent
tickets.body: Noticed decimal places are inconsistent across columns in one of our recurring exports, some show two, some show none. Small thing, would be good to standardise.

tickets.subject: API — response time question
tickets.body: Our integration calls to the /data endpoint are averaging about 800ms response time. Is this within the expected range, or should we be seeing faster responses? We're pulling relatively small datasets (under 5,000 rows per call). Happy to share request details if that helps benchmark.

tickets.subject: Connector setup — mapping question for nested JSON
tickets.body: We're setting up a connector for a source that returns nested JSON. The field mapper seems to only handle flat structures — is there a way to map nested fields, or do we need to flatten the data on the source side first? Our data team would prefer to handle this within the platform if possible.

tickets.subject: Export — question about character encoding
tickets.body: We're exporting data that includes Nordic characters (å, ä, ö) and some of them are appearing as garbled characters in Excel. The CSV is opening correctly in a text editor, so the file itself seems fine — it may be an encoding declaration issue. Is the export UTF-8 with BOM or without?

tickets.subject: Report builder — conditional formatting not working
tickets.body: I've set up conditional formatting rules on a report — colour coding cells based on value ranges. The rules are saved and visible in the settings, but the formatting is not being applied in either the report view or the export. I've tried removing and re-adding the rules. The feature simply isn't working. We've been waiting on a fix for a related display issue since February and I'm starting to lose confidence that the report builder is stable.

tickets.subject: Dashboard — widgets not respecting layout on print
tickets.body: When we print a dashboard (or export to PDF), the widget layout collapses — widgets stack vertically instead of maintaining the grid layout. The on-screen layout looks fine. We share printed dashboard summaries with stakeholders who don't have access to the platform, so this matters for us.

tickets.subject: Shared dashboard — viewer sees different data than owner
tickets.body: We have a shared dashboard where one of our viewers is seeing different data than the dashboard owner. Same filters, same time range. The viewer has fewer data permissions but the filters should be controlling what's visible regardless. Is there a permission-filtering interaction that could cause this? It's causing confusion and distrust in the data.

tickets.subject: Export fails every time — cannot get data out of the platform
tickets.body: Every export attempt this week has failed. The job shows as 'completed' in the log but no file is delivered. This is the second time we've had this problem this year. We have a client deliverable that relies on this data. Please escalate.

tickets.subject: Exports still broken — different user, same problem
tickets.body: Ville raised the export failure last week. I'm raising it again because I'm now experiencing the same thing from my account, so this isn't user-specific. The platform is simply not delivering export files. We cannot get data out. This needs to be fixed today.

tickets.subject: Connector sync — stopped working entirely
tickets.body: The main data connector has stopped syncing. Last successful sync was August 10. Status shows 'active' but nothing is running. We've had recurring connector issues throughout the year and this is now affecting live reporting. Open until resolved.

tickets.subject: Dashboard — date range question
tickets.body: Our finance dashboards are set to show the current fiscal year (April to March). The standard date range options don't include a fiscal year preset. Is there a way to set a custom fiscal year definition, or do we need to manually select a custom date range each time? We'd like to set it once and have it apply consistently.

tickets.subject: Export to PDF — formatting issue with wide tables
tickets.body: When we export a report with many columns to PDF, the table overflows the page width and columns on the right are cut off. We have a 14-column report that we need to share with the finance team. Is there a landscape/fit-to-page option for PDF exports? I haven't been able to find one.

tickets.subject: Connector setup — connecting to on-premise data source
tickets.body: We have a financial data source running on-premise behind our firewall. The connector documentation covers cloud sources but not on-premise setups. Is there a proxy agent or tunnel option that would allow the platform to connect to an on-premise database securely?

tickets.subject: Scheduled export — adding recipient
tickets.body: We need to add a second email recipient to a scheduled export. I can see the current recipient in the settings but there's only one field. Is there a way to add multiple recipients, or would we need to set up a separate job for each recipient?

tickets.subject: API access — where are our credentials?
tickets.body: We've been told by our account manager that API access is included in our Standard plan, but I cannot find an API key or credentials section in the admin panel. I've looked under Settings, Integrations, and Admin. Where is this located? I've been waiting three days for a response from account management and have now raised it here.

tickets.subject: Report builder — cannot build report with more than 10 columns
tickets.body: I'm trying to build a financial summary report with 15 data columns. The report builder allows me to add columns up to 10, and after that the 'Add column' button becomes inactive. Is there a limit on columns? If so, this is a significant constraint for finance reporting use cases. I raised this with account management in October and never got a definitive answer.

tickets.subject: Cannot see billing history
tickets.body: I need to access billing history for our account for our year-end audit. The admin panel shows a billing section but it just says 'Contact your account manager'. We've been trying to reach our account manager for two weeks. Can support provide billing records directly, or connect me with someone who can?

tickets.subject: Report builder — 10 column limit still in place
tickets.body: I raised the 10-column limit issue in December and received a response saying it was being reviewed. It's now February and the limit is still in place. We've worked around it by splitting our financial report into two sub-reports, which is cumbersome and makes consistent formatting difficult. Has there been any progress on this?

tickets.subject: Dashboard — showing wrong fiscal year data for second month running
tickets.body: Our main finance dashboard has been showing data from the wrong fiscal period for the second consecutive month. I reported this in January and was told it was a configuration issue on our end, which we corrected. The problem has returned. We did not change anything. This is wrong and it is causing problems in our financial reporting. We have had to add a disclaimer to every dashboard we share internally saying the data needs to be verified before use. That is not acceptable for a BI platform.

tickets.subject: Connector dropped our finance data source — AGAIN
tickets.body: The finance data source connector dropped again. This is the third time in three months. Same error as before: authentication timeout. We have not changed the credentials. The connector is simply unreliable for this source. We need a proper fix, not a 'please re-authenticate' response.

tickets.subject: Dashboard fiscal year issue is back — not fixing itself
tickets.body: The fiscal year display issue is back again. Third time. I am no longer willing to accept a configuration explanation — this is a platform bug. We have done nothing differently. Every time this is 'resolved' it returns within weeks. I need a permanent fix, not a patch.

tickets.subject: Report builder — still limited to 10 columns, 5 months later
tickets.body: Five months since I first reported the 10-column limit. It is still in place. We are running two parallel sub-reports for a single financial view. This is a basic capability that the platform simply does not support at an adequate level. I would like a written commitment to either fix this or acknowledge that it will not be fixed so we can make a decision accordingly.

tickets.subject: Report builder throwing errors again
tickets.body: Report builder keeps failing when I try to save a scheduled report - happened three times this morning. Please look into this today, I have a board pack due Friday.

tickets.subject: Can't add new user
tickets.body: Trying to add a new seat for our new hire and the invite email never arrives. Checked spam, nothing there. Need this working before she starts Monday.

tickets.subject: Same seat problem again
tickets.body: The seat invite issue is back - second time this month. Please fix properly this time, not just resend.

tickets.subject: Export stuck at 0%
tickets.body: Export has been stuck at 0% for twenty minutes. Cancelled and retried twice. Getting this sorted quickly would help - deadline in an hour.

tickets.subject: Connector sync failed overnight
tickets.body: Overnight sync failed again, dashboards showing yesterday's numbers this morning. This keeps happening on Fridays specifically, in case that's useful.

tickets.subject: Alert thresholds reset themselves
tickets.body: All my alert thresholds have reverted to default overnight - lost a week of tuning. Second time this has happened.

tickets.subject: Alerts still wrong after yesterday's fix
tickets.body: Thresholds are correct now but the alert emails aren't sending. One thing at a time, please.

tickets.subject: Report builder crashed mid-edit
tickets.body: Lost an hour of formatting work when the builder crashed. No error message, just gone. Please add autosave if nothing else.

tickets.subject: Connector down since this morning
tickets.body: Same connector as before is down again. Please escalate, we need this by end of day.

tickets.subject: Seat count wrong on invoice
tickets.body: Our seat count on the latest invoice doesn't match what we actually have active. Please check and correct.

tickets.subject: Still showing wrong seat count
tickets.body: Yesterday's correction didn't take - invoice portal still shows the old number. Third email on this, appreciate a fix rather than an apology.

tickets.subject: Alert spam - getting duplicates
tickets.body: Getting every alert twice since Monday. Not urgent but annoying enough to flag.

tickets.subject: Formatting reset on shared template
tickets.body: Someone's edit reset our shared quarterly template's formatting. Can this be locked down for editors below admin level?

tickets.subject: Connector timing out
tickets.body: Connector to our warehouse is timing out on the hour, every hour. Please look at this before end of week, it's disrupting the morning dashboard refresh.

tickets.subject: Export missing columns
tickets.body: Latest export is missing two columns that were there last week. Nothing changed on our end.

tickets.subject: Alert configuration — question about condition logic
tickets.body: We're trying to set up a budget variance alert that fires when the difference between actual and target exceeds 10%. I can't find a way to use a relative threshold rather than an absolute value. Is this possible in the current Alerts module, or is it on the roadmap? Happy to wait for guidance.

tickets.subject: SharePoint connector not picking up new files
tickets.body: Our SharePoint connector syncs successfully but does not detect new files added to the monitored folder. Existing files refresh fine. We added two new monthly reports to the folder on Monday and they haven't appeared. Please advise.

tickets.subject: Alert I configured last month has stopped working
tickets.body: The cash flow alert we set up in June — ticket reference from around that time — has stopped triggering. The condition was met on July 22nd and we received nothing. I had to check manually. We set these up to avoid exactly that kind of manual checking. Can you investigate what changed?

tickets.subject: PDF export layout broken — columns overlapping
tickets.body: When exporting our monthly financial summary to PDF, the right-hand columns are being truncated or overlapping. This started around the end of July. The same report exported correctly before that. We send this to leadership so presentation matters. Please look into the PDF rendering.

tickets.subject: ERP connector failing repeatedly — no resolution from last ticket
tickets.body: This is a follow-up to our August connector issue, which was apparently closed without actually being fixed. The ERP connector is still dropping every few days and requires manual restart. We've been dealing with this for nearly two months now. Each time we contact support the fix holds for a few days and then the problem returns. We need a root cause analysis, not another temporary workaround.

tickets.subject: Alerts not working AGAIN
tickets.body: Third time raising this. Alert notifications are not being delivered. I have no confidence in this feature at this point. Please just tell me if there is a known issue you're working on.

tickets.subject: API rate limit — need clarification on quota
tickets.body: We're getting 429 errors from the API intermittently. Our call volume hasn't changed significantly. I'd like to understand what our current rate limit is, how it's calculated (per minute / per hour), and whether there's a way to monitor remaining quota. The documentation doesn't make this clear. Thank you.

tickets.subject: Thanks for quick seat provisioning
tickets.body: Wanted to say thanks - the new seats were provisioned within a couple of hours of my request, much appreciated ahead of our onboarding week.

tickets.subject: Connector setup for new warehouse
tickets.body: We're migrating to a new data warehouse and need help configuring the connector. Took a bit of back and forth but support got us there in the end - thank you.

tickets.subject: Would like role-based seat templates
tickets.body: It would save us time if we could save seat and permission templates for common roles instead of setting each new hire up manually. Not urgent, just a suggestion for the roadmap.

tickets.subject: Dashboard export to PowerPoint?
tickets.body: Is there any plan to add a direct export from dashboards to PowerPoint? We currently screenshot everything for board decks, which feels clunky for a tool this good otherwise.

tickets.subject: Dashboard sharing links now working well
tickets.body: Just confirming the shared dashboard links are working smoothly since the last update - our regional leads have been using them daily without issue.

tickets.subject: New seat provisioning question - SSO groups
tickets.body: We're moving our SSO setup so seat licences are assigned automatically based on Azure AD group membership rather than manual invites. Could you confirm whether Kataja supports group-based provisioning natively, or if we'd need to handle assignment through the API on our end? Also want to check what happens to a user's saved dashboards if their seat is later downgraded from Editor to Viewer - do their existing reports remain visible to others on the team?

tickets.subject: HubSpot connector dropping custom fields
tickets.body: The HubSpot connector we set up last month has stopped pulling three custom deal properties we rely on for the pipeline dashboard - they show blank as of this week's sync, though they were populating fine through May. Nothing changed on our HubSpot side that we're aware of. Could you check whether a recent connector update affected custom field mapping? Happy to share screenshots of the field configuration if useful.

tickets.subject: SSO group provisioning still assigning wrong seat tier
tickets.body: Coming back to the group-based provisioning question from May - we did get this set up, but it's now assigning several new hires the Editor tier when their Azure AD group should map to Viewer only. We've had at least four people with edit access to shared dashboards who shouldn't have it, and we only noticed when one of them accidentally overwrote a filter on a report the whole team uses. Could someone check the group-to-tier mapping on our account?

tickets.subject: API token scopes for the HubSpot workaround
tickets.body: While we wait on the seat mapping fix, we've started pulling the HubSpot custom fields directly via your API instead of the native connector, as a temporary bridge. Could you confirm which token scope covers custom property reads specifically, since our current key seems limited to standard fields only? As part of our tooling review this year we've also been asked to take a look at Dashlume as an alternative, mainly to compare API flexibility, so it would help to understand the scope model properly either way.

tickets.subject: Report builder templates not saving custom column order
tickets.body: We've noticed that custom column ordering in report builder templates resets to default alphabetical order every time the underlying data source refreshes, which for us is daily. This means someone on the team has to manually re-sort the same handful of reports each morning before they go out. We've mentioned formatting quirks before, and while none of them individually are serious, it's the kind of thing we now just build extra time into the morning routine for rather than chase each time.

tickets.subject: Dashboard filter state resets on refresh - still happening
tickets.body: Similar story to the report builder issue we flagged in October - dashboard filters that team members set, like date range and region, reset back to default every time they reload the page rather than persisting per user. We've worked around it by pinning a saved view for each person's most common filter combination, so it's not blocking anyone day to day. Just noting it here for completeness rather than expecting a fix ahead of anything else in the queue.

tickets.subject: API rate limit question
tickets.body: We're hitting rate limits on the reporting API during our nightly batch job. Can you confirm the current limits for our Enterprise tier and whether they can be raised?

tickets.subject: API token rotation
tickets.body: Need to rotate our API token as part of a routine security review. Please advise the correct procedure so we don't break the nightly job again.

tickets.subject: Year-end export formatting
tickets.body: Ahead of year-end reporting, can you confirm whether the export template supports our fiscal calendar (April start) or if we need to adjust manually each time?

tickets.subject: Setting up budget variance alerts
tickets.body: We'd like to set up alerts when actuals vary more than 10% from budget on the finance dashboard. Can someone point me to the right configuration, or set it up on a call?

tickets.subject: New connector for accounting system
tickets.body: Jens asked me to get our accounting system connected ahead of year-end close. Could you confirm which connector type applies and any prerequisites on our side?

tickets.subject: Alert recipients need updating
tickets.body: A few people have left finance since we set these up. Please update the alert recipient list - I'll send the new names separately.

tickets.subject: Connector refresh frequency
tickets.body: We looked briefly at Storsund BI's connector documentation while benchmarking and noticed they support 15-minute refresh - is that something Kataja's connectors can match, or are we already there?

tickets.subject: Azure SQL connector — intermittent sync failures
tickets.body: Our Azure SQL connector has been failing intermittently over the past two weeks. Failures occur roughly every 3-4 days and require a manual reconnect to resolve. Error logged is 'connection reset by peer'. The Azure SQL instance itself is stable — we've confirmed no issues on the database side. This is our primary data source so each failure directly impacts reporting. Please investigate.

tickets.subject: Calculated metric not available in report filters
tickets.body: We've created several calculated metrics in the Report builder (e.g. year-over-year growth %). These appear correctly in report columns but are not available as filter criteria. We need to filter report rows by a calculated metric value — for example, show only products where YoY growth is below -5%. Is this a known limitation or is there a workaround?

tickets.subject: Critical alert not firing — this has happened before
tickets.body: One of our most important alerts (inventory threshold for a key product) did not fire on March 3rd despite the condition being clearly met. We caught it manually 18 hours later. We had a similar issue in January with the Azure connector and I'm losing confidence in the reliability of alerts as a monitoring tool. This cannot keep happening — we're an Enterprise customer and we have SLA commitments to our own clients that depend on timely alerts.

tickets.subject: API — bulk data pull performance degraded
tickets.body: Our nightly API pull that retrieves approximately 500k rows has been taking 3-4 times longer than usual over the past three weeks. The job used to complete in under 10 minutes; it's now running 35-40 minutes. Nothing has changed on our side in terms of query structure or volume. Response times on individual calls are also slower than before. Please investigate on your end.

tickets.subject: Dashboards loading blank for multiple users
tickets.body: Multiple users reported this morning that dashboards are loading as blank — no widgets, no error message, just an empty canvas. This affects at least 8 of our 15 active dashboards. Refreshing doesn't help. This follows the unresolved alert issue from March and the API slowdown. At this point I need to understand whether there is a systemic stability problem we should know about.

tickets.subject: Azure connector dropped again — fourth time this year
tickets.body: Azure SQL connector down again. Same error as before. This is the fourth time we've had to raise this. Fix it properly please.

tickets.subject: API performance still degraded — no improvement since March
tickets.body: The API performance issue we raised in March has not been resolved. Our nightly pull is still running 30+ minutes. We submitted the ticket in late March, received acknowledgement in April, and have had no substantive update since. We have adjusted our pipeline schedule to compensate but this is not a permanent solution. Please provide a timeline for resolution.

tickets.subject: Great support setting up ops dashboard
tickets.body: Thanks for the help getting our operations dashboard configured last week - exactly what we needed for the morning stand-up.

tickets.subject: Alert snoozing feature request
tickets.body: Would be useful to snooze an alert for a set period instead of only muting it entirely - we get repeat alerts during planned maintenance windows.

tickets.subject: Alerts working well since update
tickets.body: Just a note that the alert reliability has been noticeably better the last month or so - nothing missed that we've noticed. Good work.

tickets.subject: Connector reconnect after warehouse migration
tickets.body: We migrated our warehouse over the weekend and needed the connector re-pointed - support had it sorted same day. Appreciated, since we had a Monday deadline.

tickets.subject: Bulk seat import
tickets.body: Is there a way to bulk-import users via CSV rather than adding them one at a time? We're onboarding a new department of about twenty people.

tickets.subject: API returning intermittent 500s
tickets.body: Our integration is getting intermittent 500 errors from the reporting API, maybe one in twenty calls. Not consistent enough to reproduce reliably - flagging in case you're seeing it on your end too.

tickets.subject: New connector for HR system
tickets.body: Separate from the API issue I raised a couple of weeks ago - we'd like to connect our HR system as a new data source. What's involved on our side?

tickets.subject: Report builder template working nicely
tickets.body: The new template structure support has made building our monthly ops report much faster. Thanks for the walkthrough call last week.

tickets.subject: API documentation question
tickets.body: Quick question on the API docs - is there a way to pull historical snapshots rather than just current state? Couldn't find it in the reference.

tickets.subject: Alerts configured for shift handover
tickets.body: Got the shift handover alerts set up with support's help - working exactly as we hoped for the night team.

tickets.subject: Connector for second warehouse instance
tickets.body: We're adding a second warehouse instance for a new site. Could the connector support pulling from both under one account, or do we need a separate connection?

tickets.subject: Would like webhook support
tickets.body: Following on from the API question in March - it would help a lot if there were webhooks for report completion rather than us polling. Understand if that's a bigger piece of work.

tickets.subject: Alert escalation chains
tickets.body: Is it possible to set up an alert that escalates to a second contact if the first doesn't acknowledge within a set time? Useful for our on-call rotation.

tickets.subject: New site dashboard live
tickets.body: The dashboard for the new site is up and running smoothly - thanks for the patience while we worked out the metrics definitions.

tickets.subject: Escalation chains working well
tickets.body: The escalation chain feature from the summer has been solid through a full quarter of on-call rotations now. Good addition.

tickets.subject: Second warehouse connector question
tickets.body: Circling back on the second warehouse connector we set up in April - noticed it's pulling duplicate rows since last week's update. Not urgent, just flagging before it becomes a bigger cleanup job.

tickets.subject: Report builder onboarding went smoothly
tickets.body: Just finished setting up our first few report templates - the guided builder made it much easier than I expected. Thanks to the onboarding team.

tickets.subject: API access for year-end reporting
tickets.body: Needed API access sorted quickly before year-end close and the team turned it around even over the holiday period. Much appreciated.

tickets.body: Could we get an alert type that fires when expected data simply hasn't arrived, rather than only when a number crosses a threshold? We had a silent connector failure last week that a threshold alert wouldn't have caught.

tickets.body: Would it be possible to schedule exports directly to a shared network drive instead of email? Our team currently forwards the email attachment manually every week.

tickets.subject: Dashboard filters working well

tickets.subject: New connector took a while but got there
tickets.body: The new connector setup took longer than expected, more on our end than yours, but we're up and running now. Appreciate the follow-up calls.

tickets.subject: Export file size — large report taking long to download
tickets.body: One of our monthly exports (about 80k rows, 40 columns) generates a file that takes several minutes to download once the job completes. The export job itself seems to finish quickly. Is there a compression option or a way to split large exports automatically? Just flagging in case there's an easy fix.

tickets.subject: API pagination question
tickets.body: Working through the reporting API and want to confirm the correct pagination pattern for large result sets - the docs example seems to cap at 100 rows.

tickets.subject: Export taking longer than usual
tickets.body: Jens flagged that our scheduled exports have been slower than normal the last couple of weeks, sometimes twenty minutes instead of a few. Not blocking anything yet but wanted to note it.

tickets.subject: Dashboard permissions question
tickets.body: Trying to understand the permission levels for dashboard editing versus viewing - documentation wasn't quite clear on the difference between the two editor roles.

tickets.subject: API usage report
tickets.body: Could someone send over a usage report for our API calls this quarter? We're trying to work out if we're close to any plan limits.

tickets.subject: Seat reassignment
tickets.body: Need to reassign a couple of seats from people who've moved teams internally - is that something we can do ourselves in admin, or does support need to action it?
